title: Schema delta: mustChangePassword en User + migracion
acceptance: WHEN `npx prisma validate` runs against `prisma/schema.prisma` THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.
WHEN `prisma/schema.prisma` is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL show `mustChangePassword Boolean @default(false)` as a field of the `User` model.
WHEN `npx prisma migrate dev --name add_must_change_password` runs against the local database THE SYSTEM SHALL create a new migration directory under `prisma/migrations/` and apply it without error.
WHEN `npx prisma migrate status` runs afterward THE SYSTEM SHALL report the database schema up to date with no pending migrations.

WHEN the generated migration SQL is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL show `mustChangePassword` added with a default of `false`, so every existing account keeps working without being forced through the change-password flow.
WHEN `npm run build` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, confirming the regenerated Prisma Client compiles against the updated schema.
verify: npm run lint && npx jest && npm run build

title: Nucleo de auth: mustChangePassword en JWT y session
acceptance: WHEN `types/next-auth.d.ts` is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL declare `mustChangePassword: boolean` on both the `JWT` interface and `Session.user`.

WHEN the `jwt` callback in `lib/auth.ts` runs for any authenticated token THE SYSTEM SHALL re-query `User.mustChangePassword` from the database for that token's `id`, regardless of `role`, and assign the result to `token.mustChangePassword`.
WHEN the `session` callback in `lib/auth.ts` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL mirror `token.mustChangePassword` onto `session.user.mustChangePassword`.

WHEN `npx jest` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL still report the existing suite passing, since this step changes no `lib/landing/**`, `lib/productos.ts`, `lib/contacto.ts`, `lib/precios/**`, `lib/ubicaciones.ts` or `lib/utils/**` module.
WHEN `npm run build` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with `mustChangePassword` type-checking cleanly wherever the augmented `next-auth` types are read.
verify: npm run lint && npx jest && npm run build

title: Guarda de middleware para el cambio forzado
acceptance: WHEN an authenticated request carries `token.mustChangePassword === true` and requests a path other than `/cambiar-password`, `/login`, or one starting with `/api` THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to `/cambiar-password`.
WHEN that same token requests `/cambiar-password` itself THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT redirect.
WHEN that same token requests a path starting with `/api` THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT redirect, so `fetch('/api/auth/session')` keeps working during the forced flow.
WHEN `token.mustChangePassword` is `false` or absent THE SYSTEM SHALL apply the existing `/admin` and `/chofer` guards exactly as before, unchanged.

WHEN `lib/auth/middleware.ts` is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL implement the new gate as a single inline conditional inside `updateSession`, with no new exported function — matching the file's existing all-inline style.
verify: npm run lint && npx jest && npm run build

title: Componente PasswordInput con toggle mostrar/ocultar
acceptance: WHEN `components/ui/PasswordInput.tsx` renders THE SYSTEM SHALL show a native `<input>` whose `type` starts as `password`.
WHEN a user activates the toggle `<button>` THE SYSTEM SHALL switch the underlying input's `type` to `text`, and activating it again SHALL switch it back to `password`.

WHEN the field is hidden THE SYSTEM SHALL set the toggle's `aria-label` to `Mostrar contraseña` and `aria-pressed=false`; WHEN visible THE SYSTEM SHALL set `aria-label` to `Ocultar contraseña` and `aria-pressed=true`.
WHEN `components/ui/PasswordInput.tsx` is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL declare the toggle as a native `<button type=button>`, never a `<div>` with a click handler.
WHEN `npm run build` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, confirming the component type-checks standing alone, before any other file imports it.
WHEN `components/ui/PasswordInput.tsx` is measured THE SYSTEM SHALL be 300 lines or fewer.
verify: npm run lint && npx jest && npm run build

title: Login adopta PasswordInput
acceptance: WHEN `/login` renders THE SYSTEM SHALL show the password field via `PasswordInput` instead of a raw `input type=password`.
WHEN a visitor activates the reveal toggle on `/login` THE SYSTEM SHALL show the typed password in cleartext, and activating it again SHALL hide it.
WHEN a visitor submits valid credentials on `/login` THE SYSTEM SHALL still authenticate and redirect by role exactly as before.
WHEN `app/login/page.tsx` is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL contain zero raw `input type=password` elements.
WHEN `npm run build` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.
verify: npm run lint && npx jest && npm run build

title: Accion cambiarPassword (autoservicio)
acceptance: WHEN `app/cambiar-password/actions.ts` is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL export a `use server` action `cambiarPassword(actual, nueva)` that loads the current user via `auth()` from `@/lib/auth` and returns `{ error: 'No autorizado' }` when there is no session.

WHEN the source is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL gate on `bcrypt.compare(actual, user.password)` before accepting a new password, returning `{ error: 'La contraseña actual no es correcta' }` on mismatch.

WHEN the source is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL reject a `nueva` shorter than 6 characters with a length-error message, matching the same rule already enforced in `crearChofer` and `resetPasswordChofer`.

WHEN the source is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL reject `nueva === actual` with `{ error: 'La nueva contraseña debe ser distinta a la actual' }`, so the forced flow cannot be satisfied by resubmitting the same temporary password.

WHEN the source is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL, on success, hash the new password with `bcrypt` at cost 12 and update `User.password` together with `mustChangePassword: false` in one `db.user.update` call.
WHEN `npm run build` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, confirming the new Server Action type-checks even though no page calls it yet.
verify: npm run lint && npx jest && npm run build
grep -q "La contraseña actual no es correcta" app/cambiar-password/actions.ts

title: UI de autoservicio /cambiar-password
acceptance: WHEN an unauthenticated visitor requests `/cambiar-password` THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to `/login`.
WHEN an authenticated user with `mustChangePassword=true` views `/cambiar-password` THE SYSTEM SHALL show copy explaining the password was admin-generated and must be replaced.

WHEN a visitor submits a `nueva` shorter than 6 characters, or a `confirmar` that does not match `nueva` THE SYSTEM SHALL show a client-side error and SHALL NOT call the `cambiarPassword` Server Action.
WHEN the `cambiarPassword` Server Action returns an error THE SYSTEM SHALL display it inline and keep the form on screen.

WHEN `cambiarPassword` succeeds THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to the role-appropriate home (`admin` to `/admin/dashboard`, `visor` to `/admin/pedidos`, `chofer` to `/chofer`), the same mapping `app/login/page.tsx` already uses.
WHEN `npm run build` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, and both new files SHALL stay at or under 300 lines each.
verify: npm run lint && npx jest && npm run build

title: Admin: crearChofer y resetPasswordChofer prenden el flag
acceptance: WHEN `crearChofer` creates a new chofer account THE SYSTEM SHALL set `mustChangePassword: true` on the created `User` row, inside the same `$transaction` as today.
WHEN `resetPasswordChofer` resets a chofer's password THE SYSTEM SHALL set `mustChangePassword: true` on the updated `User` row, alongside the new password hash.
WHEN `editarChofer`, `eliminarChofer`, or `toggleActivoChofer` run THE SYSTEM SHALL be unchanged from their current behavior.
WHEN `npm run build` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.
WHEN `npx jest` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL still report the existing suite passing, since no `lib/**` module is touched by this step.
verify: npm run lint && npx jest && npm run build

title: Admin: crearUsuarioVisor prende el flag
acceptance: WHEN `crearUsuarioVisor` creates a new visor account THE SYSTEM SHALL set `mustChangePassword: true` on the created `User` row.

WHEN `app/admin/usuarios/actions.ts` is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL show exactly one occurrence of `mustChangePassword: true`, inside `crearUsuarioVisor`'s `db.user.create` call — no reset-password action exists for visor accounts, and none is added by this blueprint.
WHEN `eliminarUsuarioVisor` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL be unchanged from its current behavior.
WHEN `npm run build` and `npx jest` run THE SYSTEM SHALL both exit 0.
verify: npm run lint && npx jest && npm run build

title: Nav: link a /cambiar-password en Sidebar y header de /chofer
acceptance: WHEN an admin or visor views the sidebar's user section THE SYSTEM SHALL show a `Cambiar contraseña` link to `/cambiar-password`, positioned above `Cerrar Sesión`.
WHEN a chofer views the `/chofer` header THE SYSTEM SHALL show a link to `/cambiar-password` next to the existing sign-out control, without modifying `components/chofer/CerrarSesionBtn.tsx`.

WHEN `npm run build` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.
